IDQ20845
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Moderate Flood Warning for the Warrego River (QLD)

Issued at 9:22 am AEST on Wednesday 4 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 18


MINOR FLOODING EASING SLOWLY AT CUNNAMULLA BRIDGE
MODERATE FLOODING LIKELY AT ROCKY FROM WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON

A flood peak is downstream of Cunnamulla Bridge and approaching Rocky as the flood waters
flow downstream.

Another flood peak has passed Wallen and is approaching Cunnamulla Bridge. This flood peak
is likely to cause extended elevated river levels at both Cunnamulla Bridge and Rocky.

Warrego River downstream of Charleville:
Moderate flooding is likely along the lower Warrego River between Cunnamulla Bridge and
Rocky.

No current river level observations are available for the Warrego River at Cunnamulla
Bridge. However, based on river levels at the nearby automatic gauge, the river level at
Cunnamulla Bridge is estimated to have peaked at around the moderate flood level during
Tuesday and to be easing slowly just below the moderate flood level, with minor flooding.
The Warrego River at Cunnamulla Bridge is likely to remain above the minor flood level
(6.00 m) for the remainder of the week.

No current river level observations are available for the Warrego River at Rocky. The
river level is estimated to be near the moderate flood level and rising slowly. The
Warrego River at Rocky is likely to peak around the moderate flood level (4.00 m) from
Wednesday afternoon.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 11:00 AM AEST on Thursday 05 November 2026.
